title: CH-146 Griffon Limited Life Extension (GLLE) — pause / reassessment
analyst: TENET5 / LIRIL / PRISM agentic research lap + Grok investigation desk
thesis: The June 2026 pause of the ~$800M GLLE implementation converts the defence-procurement pattern from sole-sourcing alone into a four-point velocity/distortion cluster: Arctic OTHR radar sole-source signals, unusually short submarine competition framing, L3Harris/Saab GlobalEye sole-source signals, and now a stalled life-extension that may pivot into a multibillion-dollar replacement — against Carney-era 4%-of-GDP defence spending rhetoric.
